Here's a summary of every change made and why:

### What was changed

**`AnomalyPanel.tsx`**
The 440px right-side panel now uses `fixed inset-0 z-50` on mobile (full-screen overlay that slides in from the right) and reverts to `md:static md:w-[440px] md:border-l` on desktop — same visual as before but no longer squishes the main content on phones.

**`CommandCenter.tsx`**
- Removed `h-full overflow-hidden` from the outer and inner wrappers on mobile (`md:` prefix added) so the page can naturally scroll on small screens instead of cramming everything into viewport height.
- The canvas area (zone view + right panel) switches from `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden` to unconstrained on mobile so the zone view (300px min) and the telemetry/incidents panels stack vertically and scroll.
- Incidents list capped at `max-h-72` on mobile so it doesn't try to fill infinite space.

**`Reports.tsx`**
- Outer layout changed to `flex-col md:flex-row` so it stacks vertically on phones.
- Left sidebar hidden on mobile (`hidden md:flex`).
- New horizontal scrollable tab bar added at the top of the content area (mobile only) — shows icon + tag label for each report with an active indicator. Tapping switches the report, same as clicking the sidebar on desktop.
- Padding adjusted to `px-4 md:px-5` for tighter mobile spacing.

**`DispatchPlan.tsx`**
- Title row gets `flex-wrap gap-3` so the "Awaiting approval" badge wraps below the job title on narrow screens instead of overflowing.

**Hero.tsx, Login.tsx, IngressViz.tsx, JobsList.tsx, ActiveJob.tsx, ApprovalInbox.tsx** — already mobile-friendly; no changes needed.
